tool.name: Manus
tool.description: Autonomous general AI agent with its own sandbox computer, scheduled tasks, Telegram access and a desktop 'My Computer' mode.
tool.statusNote: Manus announced it resumed independent operations on 2026-09-01; the transition involved data backup/restore and a temporary interruption to access.
tool.practitionerNote: Team/Enterprise plans add SSO-style admin, audit logs and a no-training commitment; use those rather than personal plans for work data. Recheck contracts and data location after the September 2026 ownership transition.

dataResidency.detail: No customer-selectable data residency documented on the pages reviewed.

deployment.detail: Manus-hosted cloud sandbox, plus a desktop app that can act on the local computer with per-command approval.

auditLogging.detail: Team plan includes audit logging and an admin dashboard for usage and permissions.

soc2.detail: Team plan page states SOC 2 Type II.

iso27001.detail: Team plan page states ISO 27001 certification.

iso42001.detail: No ISO 42001 certification stated on the pages reviewed.

euAiAct.detail: General-purpose agent product; risk class depends on use and the vendor has not published an EU AI Act classification.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary SaaS; model providers barred from training on Team/Enterprise data.

tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.
